card_set: BOOSTER PACK The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You [UE21BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 Switch to active. May move to the front line.
If this character has 4500 or more BP, it gains 【Impact (1)】 (When this character attacks and wins a battle, deal 1 damage to your opponent.)
[When Played] Add up to one event card with 2 or less required energy from your sideline to your hand.
[When Attacking] All characters on your front line gain 500 BP until the end of the turn for each event card you have used this turn.
